result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where you're based, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll, tax reporting, superannuation and employee management handled in one place.

**If you're running a small business in Australia, I'd start by comparing Xero Payroll, MYOB and Reckon.** They're more relevant to Australian payroll requirements than popular US options such as Gusto or OnPay.

Here are my top recommendations.

## Best payroll software in Australia

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Great accounting integration.
- Payroll, leave, payslips and superannuation.
- STP reporting.
- Good for businesses already using Xero.

Website: [Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for established businesses)

- Payroll and accounting together.
- Employee leave and entitlements.
- Good reporting and business management.
- Useful for businesses with more involved bookkeeping.

Website: [MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Reckon Payroll**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable standalone payroll.
- STP reporting and superannuation.
- Employee payslips and leave tracking.
- Particularly suitable for smaller teams.

Website: [Reckon Australia](https://www.reckon.com/au/payroll-software/)

---

![Remote Jobs at Employment Hero](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MPuAQ5ZW1NsuOR00x4SR6QPMK9Z3BpeC9CKXOfRjsdcQBa0BFjTrK4bQV7YeZ1tuOur5h50Z1-2Phgkg4Gyl-xlkBlJfrceDh2pymbw4arE2vz0SOP2d5UBAzE5zPb5c3yw_6svK2bqZaRGXpzjdy9kku8S4wJXVANLarOW5tU3W422RKO_xGqSAo2Ldj_h3?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Employment Hero**

(Best for employee management)

- Payroll and HR management.
- Rostering and timesheets.
- Award interpretation.
- Useful for hospitality, retail and businesses with shift workers.

(Best for very small businesses)

- Simple payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Superannuation payments.
- Low-cost options for businesses with just one or two employees.

## What I'd recommend

My shortlist would be\:

| Business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–4 employees | Reckon or Payroller |
| 5–20 employees | Xero |
| Hospitality or retail | Employment Hero |
| Already using Xero | Xero Payroll |
| More complex employee management | MYOB or Employment Hero |


One important consideration: from 1 July 2026, Australia's Payday Super requirements mean employers need to pay super alongside wages rather than quarterly. Make sure your software supports the new requirements. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
